CLASS_FUNCTION_CONTRACTS.PURPOSE: Define proposed class and function contracts for the Go service implementation of the approved Issue 36 module contracts. Existing signatures are transcribed from the recorded source commit; new names and signatures are proposals derived from DP36-002 and MC36-002, not claims about existing code.

NORMATIVE_BOUNDARIES.RULE: RequirementsAnalysis.xml, Technology.xml, DevelopmentPlan.xml and the approved MC36-002 module/inter-module semantics are immutable inputs to this artifact.
Historical FC32-* and CC32-* contracts are not approval for Issue 36 and are not copied as target contracts.
All proposed symbols are design-only. This artifact does not authorize production code, migrations, tests, deployment, merge, or release.

No HTTP path or method is assigned for UnifiedPush registration or wakeToken resolution because the approved sources do not specify their exact route mapping. Both remain within the protected unversioned /conversations API surface; route mapping requires a separate contract decision before implementation.

The source repository contains no BFE Chat Android client implementation. Android push-receive and notification-activation behavior is traced to MC36-ANDROID-PUSH and MC36-NOTIFICATION-ACTIVATION, but Kotlin class/function signatures are intentionally not invented in this Go artifact.

Existing Issue 25 symbols are legacy implementation candidates only. Their current signatures do not establish that their current storage model, transaction semantics, or Centrifuge transport satisfy MC36-002.
Independent QA owns test creation and maintenance. This work must not create, modify, or delete tests.

CLASS_CONTRACT.BUSINESS_RULES: Enforce current membership and request/text limits; document ID/title are history metadata only.
CLASS_CONTRACT.TEST_PROPERTIES: Concurrent replay, conflicting replay, persistence failure and notification failure preserve ordering and idempotency.

CLASS_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Persistence failure causes no publication; delivery failure never rolls back committed history.
